meta.title: An agent's fix passed SWE-bench. Here is what its tests let through.
meta.verdict: The agent's fix passed every test, but no test checks that `set_visible(True)` actually shows a 3D plot. Chesterton found the gap and wrote the missing test.

import pytest
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from mpl_toolkits.mplot3d import Axes3D


def test_axes3d_set_visible_true():
    """
    Regression test for PR #23314: ensure that Axes3D.set_visible(True) actually
    makes the axes visible. The mutant incorrectly forced the base class visibility
    to False regardless of the input parameter.
    """
    fig = plt.figure()
    ax = fig.add_subplot(projection='3d')
    ax.set_visible(True)
    # The public API get_visible() should reflect the visibility state.
    assert ax.get_visible() is True
    plt.close(fig)
